newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-JNA wins A$5 mln Thai supply deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-JNA wins A$5 mln Thai supply deal.

text.p: JNA Telecommunications Ltd said on Monday it had won a A$5 million contract to supply the Telephone Organisation of Thailand (TOT) with its carrier access products and services.

"The contract will allow TOT to offer greater access to its digital data network. The project will give TOT a more comprehensive range of network interfaces - and a more manageable and reliable service," JNA said in a statement.
JNA said it enjoyed a long standing relationship with TOT and had worked with its Thai partner, Jasmine, and TOT on design, commission and installation for the contract.
The company said TOT has already used JNA products for a network to support last year's South East Asia Games.
At 3.15 p.m. (0515 GMT), JNA shares were steady at 65 cents.
